chunks: The height of the matter (of Religion), and its peak, and its key, and the door of all things, and the pleasure of the All-Merciful, Blessed and Exalted, is obedience to the Imam after recognising him.
Then he said: 'Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says:'
Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah, and whoever turns away — We have not sent you as a keeper over them.

key_terms.الطَّاعَةُ: Obedience — comprehensive submission to the authority of the divinely-appointed Imam
key_terms.ذِرْوَةُ الْأَمْرِ: The height/pinnacle of the matter — meaning the highest religious obligation
key_terms.مَعْرِفَتِهِ: Ma'rifa of him — doctrinal recognition of the Imam, not mere acquaintance

ai.seo_question: What is the highest obligation in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) declares that the pinnacle of all religious obligations is obedience to the Imam, but only after proper recognition (ma'rifa) of who the Imam is. The Imam then cites Quran 4:80 to establish that obedience to the divinely-appointed Imam is tantamount to obedience to Allah Himself, since the Messenger and Imam represent the same unbroken line of divine authority. This hadith was likely addressed to companions seeking to understand the hierarchy of religious duties, establishing imamate-obedience as the master-key to all other acts of worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The height of the matter (of Religion), and its peak, and its key, and doors of the things, and Pleasure of the Beneficent, Blessed and High, is the obedience to the Imam<sup>asws</sup> after recognising him<sup>asws</sup>’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High is Saying
[4:80] Whoever obeys the Rasool, so he has obeyed Allah, and whoever turns back, so We have not Sent you as a keeper over them’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurara from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “The top most matter (in religion) the most noble, the key issue, the gateway to all affairs and the pleasure of the Most Beneficent , the Most Holy, the Most High, is obedience to the Imam after finding out who the Imam is.”
The Imam (a.s.) then said, “Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, ‘
One who obeys the Messenger has certainly obeyed God. You have not been sent to watch over those who turn away from you [4:80]’”
